playAssertions.playerReads: A low route-control console with a shared four-slot output rack, four physical selector modules, top rotary dial, and amber authorization key lamp.
playAssertions.playerAction: Interact with the 3D console to open the 2D Image2 route-switch overlay, then choose an output.
playAssertions.worldResult: Runtime route-switch state opens or reveals the configured door, puzzle, robot room, or output target.
playAssertions.runtimeMustNotBake: selected output, target labels, localization, current authorization state, and reveal timing

integrationDecision: Keep the canonical `builder_route_switch_console` modelKey and replace the cooked GLB art behind it, so official runtime, builder preview, and Raw WebGPU resource paths continue to share the same semantic key.

runtimeStateBoundary.routeOutputMeaning: 2D overlay/config owned; the GLB uses empty badge bezels.
runtimeStateBoundary.selectedState: runtime/UI owned; the GLB stays neutral.
runtimeStateBoundary.authorization: GameWorld/key ownership; the GLB bakes only a neutral amber key lens.
